finding.title: Invent a Negation Helper for Only One Operand
finding.snippet: static inline f32 matanNegate(f32 param_1) { return -param_1; }

reasons: target matan__Fff improved from 99.20119 to 99.61539 but did not reach exact as claimed; runner records improved progress

finding.why: matanNegate does only return -param_1. matan invokes it for negative param_2 while leaving analogous param_1 negation direct. The worker records that a permuter identified this boundary, applying it to both operands regressed, and the retained asymmetric form changes floating-point register allocation. No semantic or reusable abstraction explains the helper.
finding.score_attribution: 99.20119% to 99.61539%, still partial. This is evidence of a retained allocation cue, not proof that unary-negation helpers can never be authentic.
finding.lint_candidate: Review new single-use trivial wrappers, especially asymmetric use across equivalent operations and gains confined to register assignment. Use a review warning rather than a universal hard error.

occurrences.detail: One helper definition, called once at line 156. The call is not counted as a second helper.
